title: Set 161

sentences.ko: 룸메이트한테 남자친구 얘기를 해야 할지 모르겠어. 이제 거의 우리랑 같이 사는 거나 마찬가지거든. 아니 짜증은 나는데, 내가 그 얘기를 꺼내면 걔가 이상하게 굴 거고, 계약도 아직 6개월이나 남았어. 모르겠다. 너라면 어떻게 할 거야?
sentences.text: I can't decide if I should say something to my roommate about her boyfriend basically living with us now. Like, it's annoying, but if I bring it up she's going to get weird about it, and we've still got six months left on the lease. I don't know. What would you do?

alts.text: Ugh, should I say something to my roommate? Her boyfriend's pretty much moved in. It's annoying, but she'll get all weird if I bring it up, and we've still got six months on the lease. I dunno. What would you do?

I am unsure whether I should speak to my roommate about her boyfriend, who has essentially moved in with us. It is rather frustrating, but I expect she would react poorly if I raised it, and we still have six months remaining on the lease. What would you do in my position?

sentences.note: **bring it up** 은 어떤 이야기를 꺼내다라는 뜻이에요. **get weird about it** 은 그 일로 분위기가 어색해지거나 이상하게 군다는 말이고, **six months left on the lease** 는 임대 계약이 6개월 남았다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 친구한테 고민 상담하면서 결론은 못 내리기

sentences.ko: 미안, 미안. 밤사이에 폰이 꺼져서 알람이 아예 안 울렸어. 옆집 개가 우편배달부한테 짖어 대서 겨우 깼다니까.
sentences.text: Sorry, sorry, my phone died overnight so my alarm never went off, and I only woke up because my neighbor's dog started barking at the mail guy.

alts.text: My bad, my phone died last night so no alarm, and I only woke up 'cause the neighbor's dog was barking at the mail guy.
I do apologize. My phone lost power overnight, so my alarm did not go off, and I only woke because my neighbor's dog began barking at the mail carrier.

sentences.note: **my phone died** 는 배터리가 다 돼서 폰이 꺼졌다는 뜻이에요. **never went off** 는 알람이 끝내 안 울렸다는 말로, go off 는 알람이 울리다라는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 아니, 실화 범죄물 또 안 봐. 너 저번 것도 보다가 중간에 잠들어 놓고 결국 어떻게 끝났는지 나한테 다 얘기하라고 했잖아!
sentences.text: No, we are not watching another true crime thing. You fell asleep halfway through the last one and then made me tell you how it ended anyway!

alts.text: Nope, no more true crime. You passed out halfway through the last one and still made me tell you how it ended!
No, I really do not want to watch another true crime program. You fell asleep halfway through the previous one and then insisted that I tell you how it ended regardless!

sentences.note: **true crime** 은 실제 사건을 다룬 범죄 다큐나 드라마를 말해요. **halfway through** 는 무엇을 하던 도중에, 중간쯤에라는 뜻이고, 캐주얼하게는 잠들다를 **passed out** 으로 말하기도 해요.

sentences.ko: 진짜 너무 재밌었는데, 베이비시터한테 9시까지 들어간다고 했거든. 그래서 디저트 나오기 전에 슬쩍 빠져야 할 것 같아. 다음엔 꼭 늦게까지 있을게, 약속해.
sentences.text: This has been so much fun, but I told the babysitter I'd be home by nine, so I'm going to have to sneak out before dessert. Next time I'm staying late, I promise.

alts.text: I've had a blast, but I told the sitter I'd be back by nine, so I gotta slip out before dessert. I'll stay late next time, promise.
I have enjoyed this evening very much, but I told the babysitter I would be home by nine, so I will need to leave quietly before dessert. I promise I will stay later next time.

sentences.note: **sneak out** 은 눈에 띄지 않게 슬쩍 빠져나가다라는 뜻이에요. 캐주얼하게는 **slip out** 도 같은 뜻으로 쓰고, **I've had a blast** 는 정말 즐거웠다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 그래서 다이어트는 또 끝났어. 일주일 내내 잘 버텼는데, 엄마가 남은 음식을 큰 쟁반 하나 가득 싸 주셨거든. 그 많은 음식을 그냥 상하게 둘 수는 없잖아, 안 그래?
sentences.text: So the diet's off again. I made it through the whole week, and then my mom sent me home with a huge tray of leftovers, and I wasn't going to just let all that food go bad, you know?

alts.text: Welp, diet's off again. Made it the whole week, then my mom sent me home with a giant tray of leftovers, and I wasn't gonna let all that go to waste, right?
I am afraid I have abandoned my diet once again. I managed the entire week, but then my mother sent me home with a large tray of leftovers, and I was not willing to let all of that food spoil.

sentences.note: **the diet's off** 는 다이어트를 접었다는 뜻이에요. **made it through** 는 힘든 기간을 끝까지 버텨 냈다는 말이고, **go bad** 는 음식이 상하다라는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 3번 formal 의 I would rather we did not watch 는 text 의 단호한 거절(we are not watching)을 부탁 정도로 눅여서 뜻이 약해졌으므로 I really do not want to watch 로 고침
